messages:
Priya: Need final asset checklist for the upcoming benchmark webinar. Deck, one-pager, social cards, and a 30s promo GIF. Deadline: 5 days.
Evan: I'll own the deck + speaker one-pager. Can design give templates with grid and slide counts?
Kai: Design ask: 16:9 keynote/master, and 4:5 variants for socials. Also need PNG thumbnails at 1200x628, 800x800, and 1080x1920 for stories.
Ivy: For the GIF: 600x315, loop <= 3s, filesize <250KB. Keep animation to simple sparkline + headline reveal.
Priya: Messaging pointers: Lead with "Serving wins: latency & cost". Include two CTA lines: "See the benchmark" and "Request a demo".
Evan: Deck structure suggestion: 1) tl;dr benchmark results, 2) methodology + dataset, 3) latency vs cost charts, 4) rollout recommendations, 5) customer impact + CTA. Keep deck under 20 slides.
Kai: Need the raw chart exports (SVG & PNG) from analytics. Prefer vectors for slide crispness. Can ops share?
Priya: Ops will export SVGs. Also include CSVs for reproducibility.
Ivy: Brand compliance: LegalBot, we need a quick run for claims like "3x cheaper" and latency numbers. Who signs off?
LegalBot: I'll review claims. Please attach benchmark methodology doc and raw numbers. Turnaround ~24 hours once received.
Kai: File naming convention for exports: webinar_bench_v1_{asset}_{variant}.{ext} (e.g., webinar_bench_v1_slide_deck.pdf). Use tags: _intl for localized variants.
Evan: Speaker one-pager: 1 page, 2-column layout, bullets for talking points, callouts for benchmark highlights. PDF + editable Figma frame.
Ivy: Accessibility checks: contrast >=4.5:1 for text, alt text for all images, and transcript for GIF content. Add keyboard-focus styles for interactive prototypes.
Priya: Localization: need EN + DE + FR versions for the 2 target regions. Copy handoff to localization team by EOD Tuesday.
Kai: Delivery formats to export: PDF (print-optimized), PPTX, PNGs at 2x for retina, SVGs for charts, MP4 fallback for GIF.
ArtOps: I'll prepare an asset manifest spreadsheet with columns: filename, type, dimensions, language, owner, deadline, delivery link. Will share by EOD tomorrow.
Ivy: Motion spec: 3-frame sparkline for GIF, easing: ease-out 200ms for headline, loop delay 500ms. Provide `.json` Lottie only if filesize permits.
Priya: Timeline recap: 5-day launch prep. Day 1: templates + manifest, Day 2: first pass assets, Day 3: legal + localization, Day 4: QA + accessibility, Day 5: final handoff to ops.
Evan: I'll sync with speakers to lock quotes and bios. Need speaker headshots 600x600 by Day 2.
Kai: Figma link for templates: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/webinar-benchmark-templates Will create frames: deck_master, social_4x5, gif_frames.
Priya: Great. Please prefix all files in Figma with `bench_webinar_v1-` and include export settings in each frame.
ArtOps: Once uploaded I'll run Litmus for email and a quick cross-client check for hero thumbnails.
LegalBot: Attach methodology and raw CSVs when ready. I'll flag any language edits inline in the Figma file.
Priya: Thanks team. Let's aim to have the manifest + first-pass slides in the Figma file by EOD tomorrow. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
